Coerce an identifier value to the storedAs type declared in the entity's id mapping, so that point-lookup queries target the BSON type actually on disk.
coerceIdToStoredType(java.lang.Object, org.grails.datastore.mapping.model.PersistentEntity) - Method in MongoCodecSession
If the entity's id mapping declares storedAs and it differs from the in-memory native key type, coerce the key so that update/delete filters target BSON values of the correct type (otherwise {_id: "<hex>"} sent as a BSON String would never match an _id: ObjectId(...) document on disk, and the write would silently miss, surfacing as a misleading OptimisticLockingException).
